summary: Delta re-audit passes: W4-1 is fixed (conanfile.py:41 now url = "https://erratique.ch/software/topkg", no forbidden placeholder, placeholder/secret scan clean), W4-2 is fixed (notes.md:23-24 now documents ocamldep -sort dependency order and why the upstream mllib order is unusable, matching build() conanfile.py:159-198), W4-4 is fixed (test-report.md:45 now separates 14 program assertions from the 7 artifact + 6 status shell assertions), W4-5 dates are unified, and W4-6 is fixed (conanfile.py:161-167 no longer masks ocamldep stderr and raises ConanException when order.txt is empty). W4-3's documented `set -u` (no `set -e`) deviation is accepted as sound for a POSIX sh test harness invoked via `sh` (pipefail is not POSIX; the script accumulates every check and exits non-zero on any failure), and W4-7's interface-parity `shared` option is accepted per the xmlm/ocamlbuild precedent. sha256 re-verified against the tarball (20da062dc9cea21b5c728f22c986ed3e3d57310e643260160a802d559712f6fc), the archive-order code path is unchanged and correct, and no new issues were introduced; the only residual is a cosmetic duplicated closing trailer in notes.md (P3).
